replies.body:
Heeyho 7DS,

The warn was issued around 6 months ago, not 8. If you have evidence that the warn was false, please provide it. I just see a warn that I'd not appealed. Means you have 3 infractions on that account. 

And how to noticed the infractions from the other account also count in.

The account iTerraCubist has 10 unappealed infractions in the last 8 months. Therefore you are eligible for an excessive infractions ban.
